identity.name: Radiomir 8 Days
identity.one_liner: Panerai's 45mm hand-wound Radiomir with an 8-day power reserve from the twin-barrel P.5000 movement, produced 2019-2021.

narrative.story: The Radiomir name traces to the radium-based luminous compound Panerai patented in 1915 for military dive instruments. The modern Radiomir 8 Days keeps the cushion-shaped wire-lug case of the original line while running the in-house hand-wound P.5000 movement, whose twin barrels give an 8-day power reserve. Panerai discontinued PAM00992 in 2021.
narrative.collector_notes: Manual winding and exposed wire lugs (rather than the Luminor's crown-guard bridge) are the key differences from Panerai's other lines; check the plexiglass front crystal for scratches, since it is softer than the sapphire exhibition caseback.
